title: CLI Calculator (end-to-end REPL)
prompt: Build a command-line calculator application in Python. The REPL entry point MUST be a file named main.py, runnable as `python3 main.py`, that reads one expression per line from stdin (e.g. '2 + 2') and prints its result, repeating until the user types exit or quit, at which point it must exit with status code 0. Each line is formatted as '<number> <op> <number>' with spaces around the operator, where <op> is one of + - * / ^ (^ is exponentiation). Division by zero and unparseable input must print a clear error message on one line (no traceback) and then continue the loop rather than crashing. Include a README.md explaining how to run it, and unit tests for the core arithmetic and error-handling logic using pytest (place them under tests/).

verify.description: Terminal-Bench-style: run the actual program end-to-end via stdin/stdout and check real output, not just that files exist.
